Primary request: Create one original Palari named palari-057. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- identity: tall egg pod with a low coral moon aperture and thoughtful arm
- silhouette: grounded pod with one continuous rounded ceramic body, an adult collectible proportion, and body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
- crown: simple closed dome with no open top
- opening: one deeply recessed circular aperture entirely below the face, separated from it by a continuous ceramic bridge
- pose: one rounded arm tip near the face in thought; the other rounded arm rests close to the body
- expression: attentive
- exterior material: near-black charcoal ceramic with broad readable highlights and visible microtexture
- characteristic color: deep muted coral, visually anchored to #B94F48

Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated full-body figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, coral only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening and no other structural cavity
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes above the aperture with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, coral iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one compact Palari seed mark on the lower front: exactly six circular coral apertures, four larger circles at the corners of a compact rectangle plus two smaller circles centered vertically between them; not a grille and no extra dots
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, complete full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable charcoal ceramic form and coral inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details, random holes or more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes, upward-facing cavity, circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks.
